# Nynorsk glossary — see glossary.nb.txt for the rules. The two files are
# separate because the languages are: a term correct in bokmål is not
# automatically correct in nynorsk. Language-neutral tokens (names,
# identifiers, formats) live in glossary.shared.txt instead.

# Kept pending a native ruling: used deliberately in the product, but
# unusual enough to deserve a human yes/no. Remove a line to re-flag.
anbefalar                   # 'anbefale' is contested nynorsk (tilrå is often preferred), but deliberate here
beskjæringsområde           # possibly a bokmål form leaking into the nn value (beskjering?)
filas                       # s-genitive ('filas merking') is unusual in nynorsk
